name: The Question
source:
One day, the protagonist sees his childhood friend outside of school and knows that this is the day he has to decide whether to ask her... the question. 

[From [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公在校外见到了青梅竹马。他知道，自己必须在今天决定是否要问出那个…问题。

[摘自[url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
